Strategy: Extend the winning wide band with a penalty just above it, rewarding leftovers between twenty-five and fifty and penalizing leftovers between fifty-five and seventy-five. It may help by sharpening the band edges, but may fail if the penalty hits bins that are actually useful.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 55 and r - item <= 75 else 0) for r in bins]
```
